items.reasoning: Reference: agency emailed tenant relaying the switch hint and asked to check; noted awaiting tenant. Agent did the same (A2 email to tenant, hold with review). Verified in ledger.
Correctly identifies that landlord only gave switch location, no contractor decision, awaiting tenant check; outstanding is tenant confirmation.
Emailed tenant (the channel in history) and replied to landlord by email on the existing thread. Right parties.

Did not ask for info already visible. Asked tenant to check switch (new info) and landlord for route only if still failing; the landlord was already asked in event 004 about contractor route, so the repeat is conditional and slightly redundant, but not info that's in history.

No spend, dates or outcomes committed; only a conditional promise to arrange a contractor if it still fails. Review date is internal. Tenant message says 'we will arrange for a contractor' if fails — mild but conditional on landlord approval... somewhat commits, but not spend. Acceptable.
Messages sent were verified (MSG-101/102). The first record_landlord_decision failed but was retried and verified; the answer discloses it. No false claims.

grades.overall_note: The agent's actions match what the agency actually did next: it told the tenant about the switch and held the ticket for her reply. The one minor weakness is that it asked the landlord about contractor routing again, which event 004 had already asked.
